ShortDescription.Value: Customize City Start, milestones, budget tools, milestone rewards, and optional network demolition costs.

Publish.LongDescription:
### Budget + Milestones
Set up the city the way you want — normal start, harder start, or a quick head start.
#### City Start - Keep normal milestone progression or start at a milestone you choose. - Set starting money for the next limited-money city. - Disable milestone cash bonuses if you like. - Real challenges: add demolition cost based on the network's construction cost when removing roads, paths, rail, pipes, cables, and other networks. - Game normally still refunds partially for recently built or modified networks.
#### Unlimited Money Converter - Convert an Unlimited Money save to normal limited-money budgeting. - Make a backup first. The mod cannot undo the conversion.
#### Budget Tools - Add or subtract a chosen amount with hotkeys. - Optional Auto Add Money can keep your balance above a selected threshold. - Subtract Money can take the balance below zero, just like the game allows.
#### Good to know - Lightweight design: safe to remove, no Harmony patch, or impact on city performance. - Some of these tools were originally in City Watchdog mod but now spun off and explanded with more features.
#### Languages Supported English, Deutsch, Español, Français, Italiano, 日本語, 한국어, Polski, Português Brasileiro, Português Portugal, ไทย, Türkçe, Українська, Tiếng Việt, 简体中文, and 繁體中文.
